deadline.value: Apply by December 1; no spring admission.
deadline.quote: The deadline for fall admission is December 1. There is no spring admission.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not required or accepted.
gre_general.quote: GRE Scores are not required or accepted.

gre_subject.value: GRE scores are not required or accepted.
gre_subject.quote: GRE Scores are not required or accepted.

supervisor.value: The Director of Graduate Studies advises picking a lab and emailing the faculty member before applying.
supervisor.quote: Then email the faculty member with a brief statement of your interests, your research experience (if any) and ask if the lab will be accepting students in the next application cycle.

funding.value: Six years of support guaranteed (fellowships, GRA or TA).
funding.quote: Students admitted into the program are guaranteed 6 years of support in the form of CU fellowships, graduate research assistantships, or teaching assistantships.

entry_route.value: The program is aimed at undergraduates; no master's degree is offered.
entry_route.quote: Our graduate program is for academically talented undergraduates with a strong interest in neurobiology and/or animal behavior.
